version: 0.1.0
artifact_types:
- name: FR
- name: IT
- name: US
traceability:
  trace_targets:
  - name: criterion
    archetype: FR
    section: Acceptance Criteria
    id_column: ID
  - name: scenario
    archetype: IT
    section: Test Procedure
    from: list_item
    pattern: '^(IT-\d+-SC-\d+):'
  - name: example
    archetype: US
    section: Acceptance Examples (Illustrative)
    from: heading
    pattern: '^\[(US-\d+-EX-\d+)\]'
  document_references:
  - name: verification
    archetype: FR
    section: Acceptance Criteria
    column: Verification
    row_id_column: ID
    pattern: '\b((?:IT-\d+-SC|US-\d+-EX)-\d+)\b'
    targets: [scenario, example]
  trace_tags:
    markers:
    - name: rust-trace
      language: rust
      pattern: '#\[trace\(([^)]*)\)\]'
